text: The Sleeping Beads in the Sea
The veins of Goddess Beads are found but the beads seem to\nhave lost almost all of their power. The smell of powerful\nGoddess Beads is coming from the deepest area. Go there!
Yuveria, a monster that is scattering the Goddess Beads that\nexplode easily, will destroy the beach if it goes ashore.\nFinish it off here!
The underground canyon begins to collapse due to the\nexplosions of the Goddess Beads scattered by Yuveria!\nDodge the explosions and escape as quickly as possible!
